summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ProShares S&P MidCap 400 Dividend Aristocrats ETF (REGL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P MidCap 400 Dividend Aristocrats index. The fund tracks an equal-weighted index of mid-cap companies that have increased their dividends for at least 15-consecutive years. REGL was launched on Feb 5, 2015 and is issued by ProShares.

holdings.infoBox: REGL is an equity ETF with a total of 66 individual holdings. The top holdings are Royal Gold stock at 1.94%, Avient at 1.79%, Lincoln Electric Holdings at 1.77%, Reinsurance Group of America at 1.75%, and SEI Investments Company at 1.73%.
